# Junjie Dong

> Personal academic website of Junjie Dong, Assistant Professor of Geosciences
> at Stony Brook University (mineral physics, planetary materials).
> All content (c) Junjie Dong, licensed under CC BY 4.0
> (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Any reuse, quotation, or
> summary must credit "Junjie Dong, thelattices.org" and link to the original page.

## How to cite
- Junjie Dong, "Page Title," https://www.thelattices.org/PAGE.html
- For research results, cite the published paper listed on the Papers page.
